records.message: Rotor PROP declares its axis aft; 0.58.0 counts thrust positive forward, so CT, CQ, ETA, T and the in-plane signs of this rotor are opposite to 0.57.0. See docs/upgrading.md#0580-post-tree.

simulation 6002's polar files are read from the loads export of an unsteady run, its LAST TIME STEP, one instant of a cycle, because no averaging window resolves for it; the manifest marks them kind: instant.

P6001-PROP_qs_avg_corrected.csv is the 0.57.0 per-group, per-Mach polar; 0.58.0 writes one file set per polar: the families in FAM-DIM, FAM-ACOEF and FAM-RCOEF-P6001.csv and the group qs_avg_corrected in its own group files. See docs/upgrading.md#0580-post-tree.
group 'AIRFRAME' selects no family of the loads exports of simulation '6001' (W, B); its files are not written.
records.remedy: restore the required data or correct the stated inputs and post again.
